edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. The settlement amount and payment terms remain subject to negotiation and agreement by the parties in a signed writing. No payment obligation arises unless and until the parties execute a complete written settlement agreement.

2. MUTUAL RELEASE. Upon satisfaction of the payment obligations set forth in the final executed settlement agreement, each party, on behalf of itself and its respective predecessors, successors, and assigns, releases the other party and its respective predecessors, successors, and assigns from claims arising out of or relating to the matters resolved by this Agreement, except for claims to enforce this Agreement and any claims that cannot lawfully be released. The scope and effective date of the releases remain subject to agreement in the final written settlement agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties will keep the terms of this settlement confidential, except that either party may disclose them to its attorneys, accountants, insurers, auditors, and other professional advisers who are subject to confidentiality obligations; as required by law, regulation, court order, or governmental process; to enforce or defend rights under the settlement; or with the other party’s written consent. The parties may also make disclosures reasonably necessary for tax, regulatory, or financial reporting purposes. The scope of any further confidentiality obligations remains subject to agreement in the final written settlement agreement.
